question: What cosmic power arises from continually contemplating a smoky-colored form?
premises: A smoky-colored form is to be contemplated always
The triple world is the object affected
The practitioner gains the power to shake it
inference: By always contemplating a smoky-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoky-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
